inj.note: Diaby exited this past Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons with the knee injury, which was revealed to be a Grade 2 MCL sprain following an MRI on Monday, per reporters. Though Diaby will miss at least one game due to the injury, Bowles expressed hope that the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye would aid the edge rusher's recovery and allow him to avoid a stint on injured reserve.

news.h: Source: Buccaneers pass rusher Yaya Diaby has Grade 2 MCL sprain
news.d: Buccaneers outside linebacker Yaya Diaby suffered a Grade 2 MCL sprain in Sunday's 16-0 victory over the Falcons.
